Maximum XOR Path in Tree

You are an intergalactic data scientist studying quantum entanglement networks. The network is modeled as a tree with N nodes, each assigned a quantum signature value. The XOR coherence score of a path is defined as the XOR of the quantum signature values of all nodes along the path.

Given the tree structure and node values, find the maximum XOR coherence score across all possible node-to-node paths in the tree (a path from any node to any other node is valid).
explanation: Using a Trie-based approach with prefix XOR. The XOR of any path from node u to node v equals prefix_xor[u] XOR prefix_xor[v] where prefix_xor[x] is the XOR from root to x. We perform a DFS and compute prefix XOR values from root to each node. Then, we insert every prefix XOR into a binary Trie (bit by bit from MSB to LSB). For each prefix XOR, we query the Trie greedily — at each bit, try to choose the opposite bit to maximize XOR. The maximum across all such queries is the answer.
